subject: Concentric renewal + capacity growth — pricing conversation
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@concentrichealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@venture-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Concentric renewal + capacity growth — pricing conversation

Rishi,

Hope you had a good week. We're approaching our August 2027 renewal and the product team is forecasting a 2.5x increase in generation volume as we roll out the patient-notification feature. We want to lock in predictable economics while preserving flexibility for the first half of the year.

High-level asks from Concentric:
- 12 month renewal starting 2027-08-01 with an option to extend to 24 months
- A 6-month price hold on any per-token increases while adoption ramps
- A one-time onboarding credit to offset migration and QA costs
- A burst buffer for unexpected surges (roughly 20% above committed capacity)

We'd like an initial sense of whether those are doable and any constraints on price holds or true-up mechanics you typically require. Procurement timeline: aim to have commercial terms agreed by 2026-11-15 so legal/procurement can route.

Thanks,
Asha Kapoor
Head of Platform Partnerships
Concentric Health

Attachments: none in this message

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@concentrichealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Concentric renewal + capacity growth — pricing conversation

Asha — thanks for the clear context, and congrats on the upcoming product rollout. Short answer: we can get close to your asks with a structured approach that balances your desire for predictability and our capacity planning.

Initial commercial sketch (for discussion):
- Committed annual token volume with a 15% discount to current list for year 1 (applies to committed units).
- One-time onboarding credit: $75,000 applied as invoice credit within first 60 days.
- Price hold: 90-day guaranteed per-token price protection from contract effective date; optional 90-day extension contingent on hitting adoption milestone (see below).
- Burst pool: 20% burst capacity with metered overage at list rate but with a 50% cushion on billing for first two surge events per year.
- True-up mechanics: quarterly true-ups with a 45-day invoice reconciliation window; failure to meet minimums may trigger step-down to a safety discount of 8% after year 1.

I'm attaching recent Q3 usage to validate the uplift sizing and a short proposal doc with initial numbers. If you can share target months for the ramp we can simulate blended unit economics.

Happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Concentric_usage_Q3.csv (usage export), initial-proposal-20261102.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Concentric renewal + capacity growth — pricing conversation

Forwarding Rishi's draft to align on guardrails before we send a revised offer to Asha. Quick suggestions from GTM: 
- Reduce the headline discount to 12% committed (protects margin if adoption misses).
- Extend price-hold extension condition to two adoption milestones (both must be met) rather than one.
- Add an SLA credit language for latency/availability during ramp — Concentric is very sensitive to uptime for patient notifications.
- Ask legal for a 30-day mutual termination right if regulatory issues arise (their space can be sensitive).

If we go to 12% + $75k credit and keep the burst buffer, I think it's a fair tradeoff. I'll work on the line-item redlines for finance/legal.

—Monica
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@concentrichealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Concentric Legal <legal@concentrichealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@venture-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Concentric renewal + capacity growth — pricing conversation

Rishi/Monica — thanks, that helps. A few points from procurement and legal: 

1) Price-hold duration: 180 days would be far more comfortable for our CFO given the patient-notification roll-out timeline; is that something you can extend if we commit to a defined adoption cadence?
2) Overage buffer: we like the idea of the first two surge events being softened, but we need a predictable cap on monthly overage invoicing (suggest max 40% for any billing month).
3) SLA: we can accept a standard SLA but need clearer remediation and credits for missed availability during critical windows.
4) Timeline: procurement needs final commercial terms by 2026-11-15 to hit their board cycle.

We can share precedent language for the SLA and our procurement checklist if that speeds review. If you can turn a redline term-sheet by Monday 2026-11-09 we can route internally and get legal comments back quickly.

Asha
Head of Platform Partnerships
Concentric Health

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (attached by Concentric in reply)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@concentrichealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final commercial proposal & term sheet (v3) — Concentric Health

Asha — appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. We've aligned internally and here is the revised (executable) offer we can commit to if Concentric signs the term sheet: 

Key terms (summary):
- Committed volume: annual committed token amount (per attached term-sheet-v3.pdf).
- Year 1 committed discount: 12% off list on committed units.
- Onboarding credit: $75,000 applied within first invoice cycle.
- Price hold: 90 days guaranteed from effective date, with an automatic 90-day extension (total 180 days) if both adoption milestones A and B are met within the first 120 days after go-live.
- Overage protection: 20% burst pool with a monthly overage cap of 40% of committed units; overage billed at list rate with first two surge events per contract year billed at 50% of list.
- SLA language: we accept the proposed availability credit structure; minor redline requested to preserve emergency maintenance windows.
- True-up: quarterly true-ups with 45-day reconciliation; failure to meet minimums triggers step-down to an 8% discount the subsequent renewal term.
- Term: 12 months with one 12-month optional extension.

Next steps: 
1) Attached term-sheet-v3.pdf with line items and redlines.
2) DocuSign envelope prepared: https://www.docusign.com/party/embeddedSigning?env=prod&doc=CON-4871-TMSV3 (ready for sign once legal confirms language).
3) If procurement needs a reference, we'll share a short one-pager on our latency and outage history during ramp (case studies).

If this is aligned, Monica will open the Deal in HubSpot and Finance will provision the $75k credit. Please let me know if you want a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the term sheet.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0192

Attachments: term-sheet-v3.pdf
